005package org.wpilib.command2;
006
007import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
008import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
009
010/**
011 * A base for subsystems that handles registration in the constructor, and provides a more intuitive
012 * method for setting the default command.
013 *
014 * <p>This class is provided by the Commands v2 VendorDep
015 */
016public abstract class SubsystemBase implements Subsystem, TelemetryLoggable {
017  /** Constructor. Telemetry/log name defaults to the classname. */
018  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
019  public SubsystemBase() {
020    String name = this.getClass().getSimpleName();
021    m_name = name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
022    CommandScheduler.getInstance().registerSubsystem(this);
023  }
024
025  /**
026   * Constructor.
027   *
028   * @param name Name of the subsystem for telemetry and logging.
029   */
030  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
031  public SubsystemBase(String name) {
032    m_name = name;
033    CommandScheduler.getInstance().registerSubsystem(this);
034  }
035
036  /**
037   * Gets the name of this Subsystem.
038   *
039   * @return Name
040   */
041  @Override
042  public String getName() {
043    return m_name;
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Sets the name of this Subsystem.
048   *
049   * @param name name
050   */
051  public void setName(String name) {
052    m_name = name;
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
057    var defaultCommand = getDefaultCommand();
058    table.log(".hasDefault", defaultCommand != null);
059    table.log(".default", defaultCommand != null ? defaultCommand.getName() : "none");
060
061    var currentCommand = getCurrentCommand();
062    table.log(".hasCommand", currentCommand != null);
063    table.log(".command", currentCommand != null ? currentCommand.getName() : "none");
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public String getTelemetryType() {
068    return "Subsystem";
069  }
070
071  private String m_name;
072}
